decisions.reason: The complete coherent baseline scroll sweep was visually inspected from the original PNG-derived reading strip, covering title, subtitle, notice, all six labels and visible details, unavailable reasons, summary, disclosure label, Request station, and the complete footer. The safety briefing body is deliberately collapsed and excluded from required visible text. Unavailable sometimes breaks between characters at this narrow enlarged size; every character is preserved, as expressly allowed by the brief. No word clipping, ellipsis, or missing required text was found. Native interval-union completeness and exact input/event binding were recomputed with frozen bound_state_evidence; source existence alone was not used as visual proof.

Every captured part of the coherent baseline scroll sweep was visually inspected. Header, padded notice, each of the six choice cards and its separate label/detail/reason text, summary, disclosure, primary action and footer occupy separate areas with visible gaps. No unintended text, indicator, badge, disclosure, or action overlap/occlusion was found. Viewport cuts and contact-sheet column breaks are presentation boundaries, not component overlap. Complete exact-state coverage was recomputed by frozen bound_state_evidence.
